name: workflow-directory-written-with-an-expression
description: A step whose working-directory is written with an expression, which GitHub Actions evaluates per matrix entry, runs its command in a directory the analysis does not know, so the command roots nothing and its text holds every file it names in each directory: packages/a/build.js and packages/b/build.js are held, nothing they export is reported, and the package is noted. A file no command names is still reported.
